messages:
Sam Li: Morning team — new AE here, Sam. My first-day checklist: need HubSpot seat, Aircall extension, Gainsight for CS handoffs, and access to the 'AE Quick Play' playbook. Who do I ping? :raising_hand:
Tara Nguyen: hey @Sam welcome! :tada: Sales Ops does HubSpot & Aircall. I'll start the provisioning. Can you confirm your work email and time zone?
Sam Li: sam.li@redwood.ai, PST (San Francisco).
Tara Nguyen: thx. Created ticket SALES-6132 for HubSpot + Aircall. ETA 8 business hours for HubSpot, Aircall should be same-day. I'll add you to the zoomcal integration too.
Devon Cole: hi Sam — I'm your CS partner. Gainsight needs the customer access form filled so we can map accounts. Link: https://redwood-internal/gainsight/setup
Sam Li: filled the Gainsight form just now.
Devon Cole: great. I'll schedule the 30m handoff walk-through. Also pinged @PeopleOps to sync NDAs and external training.
CSBot: SYSTEM: Seat assigned in PeopleOps queue (ticket PO-1987). Status: awaiting approval.
Tara Nguyen: FYI Aircall extension requires your device type (desktop or mobile). Also, add your preferred outbound caller ID.
Sam Li: Desktop MacBook Pro (Ventura). Caller ID: 415-555-0199 (work).
Tara Nguyen: noted. Aircall invite sent. Check spam if you don't see it.
Sam Li: got it — invite in inbox, connecting headset now. Quick question: where's the pricing cheat sheet for speaking to mid-market? I want the 10/25/50 seat tiers.
Liam O'Connor: Pricing cheat sheet is under Sales Wiki: https://redwood-internal/wiki/pricing/cheatsheet. Liam O'Connor: Also, add yourself to the "AE Slack - deal help" channel for quick price overrides.
Sam Li: thanks. One more: playbook import tip — any preferred CSV header for lead imports? Put sample below.
Tara Nguyen: yes — use headers we use for HubSpot import. Tara Nguyen: ```
email,first_name,last_name,company,job_title,lead_source,owner
``` 
Tara Nguyen: keep owner blank if assigning via round-robin.
Sam Li: perfect. I'll import the shared seed list tomorrow morning.
Devon Cole: For CS handoffs please fill the "handoff_reason" and "expected_mrr" fields in Gainsight form — otherwise tickets bounce.
Sam Li: noted. Thanks all! This was super fast :rocket:
Tara Nguyen: welcome aboard! Ping if anything blocks you.
Devon Cole: looking forward to having you on deals.
